definitions.explanation: A wound caused by a pointed object piercing the skin. Used in medical, news, and crime contexts.

examples.japanese: {腕|うで}に{刺|さ}し{傷|きず}がある。
examples.english: There is a puncture wound on the arm.

examples.japanese: {被害者|ひがいしゃ}の{体|からだ}には{複数|ふくすう}の{刺|さ}し{傷|きず}があった。
examples.english: The victim's body had multiple stab wounds.

examples.japanese: {釘|くぎ}を{踏|ふ}んでできた{刺|さ}し{傷|きず}が{化膿|かのう}しないよう、すぐに{消毒|しょうどく}した。
examples.english: I disinfected the puncture wound from stepping on a nail right away so it wouldn't get infected.

notes:
USAGE: {刺|さ}し{傷|きず} refers to wounds made by sharp, pointed objects — knives, nails, thorns, etc. It appears frequently in news reports about crimes and in medical contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {刺|さ}し{傷|きず}を{負|お}う: to sustain a stab wound
- {深|ふか}い{刺|さ}し{傷|きず}: deep puncture wound
- {刺|さ}し{傷|きず}を{手当|てあ}てする: to treat a stab wound

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {刺|さ}し{傷|きず}: puncture/stab wound (from a pointed object)
- {切|き}り{傷|きず}: cut, laceration (from a blade or edge)
- {擦|す}り{傷|きず}: scrape, abrasion (from friction)
